This part belongs to the Vertical Cloud Lab "Powder Doser" — an auger-fed,
screw-metered dry-powder dispenser. Design it as a single, manifold,
FDM-printable solid (0.4 mm nozzle, ~0.2 mm layers; fin/wall features >= 2 mm).
All dimensions are in millimetres.

Shared fits & fasteners (apply where relevant):
- M3 clearance hole = 3.4 mm dia; M3 self-tap pilot = 2.7 mm; M3 setscrew pilot = 2.5 mm.
- M5 clearance hole = 5.4 mm dia.
- Auger / collar / bracket running fit over the 25.0 mm auger OD = bore 25.5 mm.
- Printed gears: module given per part, 20 deg pressure angle.

POWDER DOSER ASSEMBLY at tilt = 0 degrees (everything flush). Build a single
combined solid (a union/compound is fine) that shows how the parts fit on a
common datum. Use the auger long axis = +Y; +Z is up; dispense tip at +Y.

Layout (millimetres):
- Mounting plate: flat slab in XY, thickness 6.0, top face at Z = 0, spanning
  X = -54 to +54, Y = -15 to +115, with a 32 mm wide U-notch open at the +Y
  edge.
- Auger: a tube outer diameter 25.0, length 250.0, lying horizontal with its
  axis along Y at Z = +29.25 above the plate top, centred on X = 0, the
  dispense end toward +Y overhanging the notch. Represent it as a plain
  cylinder with a 48-tooth-band collar (a ring outer diameter 50, width 10)
  at 83 mm from the +Y end.
- Two auger brackets (front and rear): rectangular blocks 60 (X) x 12 (Y) x
  14 (Z) on the plate top, each topped by a collar ring outer diameter 33.5
  cradling the auger at Z = 29.25, placed at Y ~ +70 and Y ~ +5.
- NEMA 11 motor block: a 28 x 28 x 32 box envelope beside the gear band at
  X = +32 (the gear centre distance) with its shaft along Y, plus a small
  16-tooth pinion ring (outer diameter 18) meshing the auger band.
- Baseplate: a flat slab X = -100 to +100, Y = +55 to +115, top face at
  Z = -8, with the two rear corners chamfered 25 x 45 deg.
- Two MG996R servo envelopes (40 x 20 x 43 boxes) on the baseplate, mirrored
  about X = 0 at X ~ +/-77, each with a small 20-tooth servo-pinion ring.
- Two M5 hinge pins: cylinders diameter 5.0 along X at the +Y end, at
  Z = +29.25, marking the tilt axis 10 mm forward of the baseplate front edge.

Keep it a clean, manifold representative model — exact gear teeth are not
required for the assembly view, but every listed block/cylinder must be
present in roughly the right place.

design_plan.notes: Build as union of all components. Auger axis along +Y at Z=29.25, centered on X=0. Mounting plate top at Z=0, baseplate top at Z=-8. Gear collar positioned 83mm from +Y end of auger (at Y approximately 167mm from auger start). Motor block at X=+32 for gear mesh. Servos mirrored at X=+/-77. Bracket collars are semicircular cradles (use full ring for simplicity). Chamfers on baseplate rear corners at 45 degrees, 25mm extent. Hinge pins span across assembly width at Y position 10mm forward of baseplate front edge (Y=65). Representative model - exact gear teeth not required, use simple rings/cylinders.

RECOMMENDED FIX: Recalculate auger Y positioning so it properly overhangs at +Y while starting within or near the plate boundary. The auger tip at +Y should be around Y = 130-140 (overhanging the notch), with the rear at approximately Y = -110 to -120. Verify all cylinder orientations are correct for Y-axis alignment.

import cadquery as cq

# ============================================================
# Powder Doser Assembly - Complete Assembly View
# ============================================================

# Key dimensions (all in mm)
# Mounting plate
mp_x_min, mp_x_max = -54.0, 54.0
mp_y_min, mp_y_max = -15.0, 115.0
mp_z_thickness = 6.0
mp_top_z = 0.0
mp_u_notch_width = 32.0

# Auger
auger_od = 25.0
auger_length = 250.0
auger_axis_z = 29.25
auger_axis_x = 0.0

# Gear collar (48-tooth band)
gear_collar_od = 50.0
gear_collar_width = 10.0
gear_collar_from_tip = 83.0  # from +Y end

# Brackets
bracket_x = 60.0
bracket_y = 12.0
bracket_z = 14.0
bracket_collar_od = 33.5
front_bracket_y = 70.0
rear_bracket_y = 5.0

# NEMA 11 motor
nema_x = 28.0
nema_y = 28.0
nema_z = 32.0
nema_center_x = 32.0  # gear center distance

# Motor pinion (16-tooth)
pinion_od = 18.0

# Baseplate
bp_x_min, bp_x_max = -100.0, 100.0
bp_y_min, bp_y_max = 55.0, 115.0
bp_z_thickness = 8.0
bp_top_z = -8.0
bp_chamfer = 25.0

# Servos (MG996R)
servo_x = 40.0
servo_y = 20.0
servo_z = 43.0
servo_center_x = 77.0

# Servo pinion (20-tooth)
servo_pinion_od = 20.0

# Hinge pins
hinge_pin_dia = 5.0
hinge_pin_z = 29.25

# ============================================================
# Build components
# ============================================================

# 1. Mounting Plate with U-notch
mp_width = mp_x_max - mp_x_min  # 108
mp_length = mp_y_max - mp_y_min  # 130

# Create base plate - bottom at Z = -6, top at Z = 0
mounting_plate = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(0, (mp_y_min + mp_y_max) / 2, -mp_z_thickness / 2))
    .box(mp_width, mp_length, mp_z_thickness, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# Cut U-notch at +Y edge
u_notch_depth = 30.0  # how far the notch extends into the plate
u_notch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(0, mp_y_max - u_notch_depth / 2, -mp_z_thickness / 2))
    .box(mp_u_notch_width, u_notch_depth + 1, mp_z_thickness + 2, centered=(True, True, True))
)
mounting_plate = mounting_plate.cut(u_notch)

# 2. Auger tube (cylinder along Y axis)
# Dispense end at +Y overhanging the notch
# Position auger so tip is at Y ~ 135 (overhanging notch which ends at Y=115)
# and rear end at Y ~ 135 - 250 = -115
auger_tip_y = 135.0  # +Y end (dispense tip)
auger_rear_y = auger_tip_y - auger_length  # -Y end (-115)
auger_center_y = (auger_tip_y + auger_rear_y) / 2  # center at Y = 10

auger_tube = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .transformed(offset=(auger_axis_x, auger_center_y, auger_axis_z))
    .cylinder(auger_length, auger_od / 2, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 3. Gear collar (48-tooth band) - ring at 83mm from +Y end
gear_collar_center_y = auger_tip_y - gear_collar_from_tip  # 135 - 83 = 52

# Outer cylinder of collar
gear_collar_outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .transformed(offset=(auger_axis_x, gear_collar_center_y, auger_axis_z))
    .cylinder(gear_collar_width, gear_collar_od / 2, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 4. Front auger bracket with collar ring
# Rectangular block topped by collar ring cradling auger
front_bracket_base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(0, front_bracket_y, mp_top_z + bracket_z / 2))
    .box(bracket_x, bracket_y, bracket_z, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# Collar ring on top (simplified as full ring)
front_bracket_collar = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .transformed(offset=(0, front_bracket_y, auger_axis_z))
    .cylinder(bracket_y, bracket_collar_od / 2, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 5. Rear auger bracket with collar ring
rear_bracket_base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(0, rear_bracket_y, mp_top_z + bracket_z / 2))
    .box(bracket_x, bracket_y, bracket_z, centered=(True, True, True))
)

rear_bracket_collar = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .transformed(offset=(0, rear_bracket_y, auger_axis_z))
    .cylinder(bracket_y, bracket_collar_od / 2, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 6. NEMA 11 motor block
# Position at X = +32 (center distance), beside the gear band
# Motor shaft along Y
nema_center_y = gear_collar_center_y
nema_center_z = auger_axis_z

nema_block = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(nema_center_x, nema_center_y, nema_center_z))
    .box(nema_x, nema_y, nema_z, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 7. Motor pinion (16-tooth ring)
pinion_width = 8.0
motor_pinion = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .transformed(offset=(nema_center_x, gear_collar_center_y, auger_axis_z))
    .cylinder(pinion_width, pinion_od / 2, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 8. Baseplate with chamfered corners
# Top face at Z = -8, bottom at Z = -16
# Chamfers on two rear corners (at +Y end) at 45 degrees, 25mm extent
pts = [
    (bp_x_min, bp_y_min),  # bottom-left (-100, 55)
    (bp_x_max, bp_y_min),  # bottom-right (100, 55)
    (bp_x_max, bp_y_max - bp_chamfer),  # before top-right chamfer (100, 90)
    (bp_x_max - bp_chamfer, bp_y_max),  # after top-right chamfer (75, 115)
    (bp_x_min + bp_chamfer, bp_y_max),  # before top-left chamfer (-75, 115)
    (bp_x_min, bp_y_max - bp_chamfer),  # after top-left chamfer (-100, 90)
]

baseplate = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(0, 0, bp_top_z - bp_z_thickness))
    .polyline(pts)
    .close()
    .extrude(bp_z_thickness)
)

# 9. Left servo envelope (MG996R)
# Mirrored at X = -77, sitting on baseplate top (Z = -8)
bp_center_y = (bp_y_min + bp_y_max) / 2  # 85

left_servo = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(-servo_center_x, bp_center_y, bp_top_z + servo_z / 2))
    .box(servo_x, servo_y, servo_z, centered=(True, True, True))
)

# 10. Right servo envelope
right_servo = (
